bundle.shortDescription: Local-first unified messaging for your desktop
bundle.longDescription:
Shuttle is a local-first unified messaging desktop app. One inbox for WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Instagram, Matrix, and email — on your machine, not in the cloud.

Created by Sheese Sheikh (https://shee.se, github.com/smsheese).
